Thanks Emma — this is perfect. Welcome!

Quick confirmations and next steps:
1) Please complete our Buyer Intake worksheet at: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1IntakeFormID (fillable PDF). I'll use that to create the vendor record.
2) For PO issuance: we require legal entity, remit address, W‑9, and a primary AP contact. POs are issued against the vendor record and referenced on invoices.
3) Payment rails:
   - ACH (preferred): we can pay on NET30 after invoice matching. Provide ACH routing + full account number in the intake form (we mark it private).
   - Wire: accepted for expedited payments — we require bank letter and beneficiary name exactly as the legal entity.
4) Tax terms: our system requires EIN and W‑9 on file to map tax classification.

I'll create the vendor record once I receive the completed intake PDF. Marcus will loop in PO numbering and S/OW details.

Mina Haddad
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | (510) 555-4123

Thanks — two operational notes:
- PO cadence: We typically issue a single PO per quarter for platform credits and then smaller POs for professional services. If you prefer an invoice-only relationship, confirm billing contact and invoice format.
- Pricing/tax: If Hearth Labs is GST/VAT registered outside the US in future, we'll need tax registration docs to adjust withholding.
- Accounting remittance: once vendor is created, invoices should be sent to ap-invoices@redwood.com with the PO number in the subject.

Emma, could you add a point of contact for statement-of-work approvals (name/email) and confirm whether invoices will include a purchase order number? If not, we'll set a default PO assignment process.

On the intake form, please put ACH details in the 'Banking' section — we'll redact when storing.

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
